description: ImageNet transfer-learning reference; same split and augmentation.

split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold; outer 5-fold test holdout, inner 4-fold validation from the remaining data
split.test_policy: Held-out test set is evaluated once after checkpoint/model selection; it is not used for tuning

augmentation.applies_to: training split only, on the fly after split assignment
augmentation.validation_test: deterministic resize, tensor conversion, ImageNet normalization only
